prompts.atardecer_izq: Qwen (relight 2025): Relight this exact image as a golden hour sunset. Warm low orange sunlight comes from the left and rakes across the landscape: glowing orange and amber highlights on every ridge, rock, tree and plant, long soft shadows on the opposite sides, warm golden color grading. Vegetation keeps its natural green color, only lit by the warm golden light. There is no sky in this image: everything above the ridgeline, the treetops and the hilltops is the pure black background; do not paint any sky, clouds, sunset glow or distant mountains above the landscape, and keep the pale distant slopes as land. Keep every tree, plant, flower, rock, cliff, water and the whole composition exactly the same; only the lighting and colors change. Do not add any waterfall or new element. Crisp clear air: no fog, no mist, no haze, no smoke and no glow along the outline; the outer silhouette stays sharp and clean against the black background. Keep the black background pure black. || Flux Krea img2img 0.5: Cinematic film still, golden hour sunset: green grassy mountain slopes of Tafi del Valle with tussock grass, scattered boulders and a lone cardon cactus. Warm low sunlight from the left rakes across the landscape with long soft shadows; rich natural colors, green vegetation stays green under the warm golden light. No waterfalls. There is no sky: above the ridgeline and the treetops everything is pure black, no sky, no clouds, no glow. Shot on ARRI Alexa with an anamorphic lens, real filmed footage, natural film grain, photorealistic, sharp detailed textures, crisp clear air, no fog, no mist, no haze, no glow along the outline. The black background stays pure black.
